title: Illuminated p-type nanowire with a shell contact in (r, z): radial minority-electron diffusion, I0 / I1 collection (analytic)
description:
A p-type silicon-like wire as a body of revolution (drift_diffusion geometry axisymmetric: x = r from the axis at x_lo, y = z): radius R = 3 um, two 5 nm cells high (a 1D radial problem), N_A = 1e22 1/m^3, n_i 1e16, a single ohmic shell contact on R - 20 nm < r < R (0 V) and uniform generation G = 1e27 1/(m^3 s) (generation feature on all; contact cells generate nothing), SRH lifetime tau_srh (no radiative term). With one contact the total current is zero: the electron and hole contact currents separate the minority diffusion current. Stationary sweep tau_srh = 1e-11..1e-9 s (diffusion length 0.19..1.87 um against R = 3 um). Low injection (excess electrons <= 4.3e17 = 4.3e-5 N_A).
Analytic: L = sqrt(D_n tau_srh), D_n = mu_n V_T; the excess electrons obey D_n (1 / r) d/dr (r d dn / dr) - dn / tau + G = 0, regular on the axis and 0 at the innermost held contact centre r_b = R - w_contact + dr / 2: dn = G tau (1 - I0(r / L) / I0(r_b / L)). The electron current into the contact through its inner face r_f = R - w_contact (whole ring, A) is I_n = q G 2 pi H L r_f I1(r_f / L) / I0(r_b / L) (= q times the generation minus the recombination of the free cylinder r < r_f, since the integral of I0(r / L) r dr is L r I1(r / L)); the collection efficiency eta = I_n / (q G pi r_f^2 H) = 2 L I1(r_f / L) / (r_f I0(r_b / L)) runs from 0.12 (L << R: about 2 L / R, the planar L / W doubled by the cylinder) to 0.78 (planar slab of the same thickness: L tanh(W / L) / W is lower).
Derived values tab: I_electron (contact electron_current, A of the whole ring, = +I_n), I_hole (-hole_current, = I_n: the total is zero), eta, R_total (ring-weighted integral of semiconductor_recombination, 1/s, against G pi r_f^2 H (1 - eta)) and N_axis (largest N, at the axis cell r = dr / 2: n0 + G tau (1 - I0(dr / 2L) / I0(r_b / L))). Expect ~1e-4 (low-injection and ambipolar corrections ~dn / N_A, discretisation ~(dr / L)^2 / 24); a missing or misplaced 2 pi r weight changes eta by tens of percent.
Sweep tab: the five derived values versus tau_srh (log axis useful) with their dashed curves.
Line profile tab (last sweep value, 1e-9 s): N_profile, the I0 profile from its maximum on the axis to n0 at the contact. Field tab: N, P, recombination, V.

parameters.name: tau_srh
parameters.description: SRH lifetime of both carriers in s (the sweep runs 1e-11..1e-9 s)

parameters.name: T_lat
parameters.description: lattice temperature in K (the semiconductor temperature setting)

parameters.name: R_wire
parameters.description: wire radius = domain width in r

parameters.name: H_wire
parameters.description: wire height in z (two cells: a 1D radial problem)

parameters.name: w_contact
parameters.description: thickness of the ohmic shell contact at the rim

parameters.name: r_f
parameters.description: inner face of the contact shell in m (free cells r < r_f)

parameters.name: r_b
parameters.description: centre of the innermost held contact cell (excess electrons 0 there)

parameters.name: flux_factor
parameters.description: L r_f I1(r_f / L) / I0(r_b / L) in m^2 (the integral of the collected fraction over r dr)

parameters.name: I_n_ref
parameters.description: analytic electron current into the contact (whole ring) in A

parameters.name: eta_ref
parameters.description: analytic collection efficiency I_n / (q G pi r_f^2 H)

parameters.name: R_total_ref
parameters.description: analytic total recombination of the free cylinder in 1/s

parameters.name: N_axis_ref
parameters.description: electron density at the axis cell centre r = dr / 2 in 1/m^3
